papers_found.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
papers_found.key_finding: LSTM + Monte Carlo dropout at inference yields calibrated sequential probabilities. Integrates rolling-form indicators + spatial shot-chart embeddings. Consistent improvements in discrimination and calibration over tree-only baselines.
papers_found.relevance: HIGH — shot-chart spatial embeddings are a feature type not currently in engine.py

papers_found.title: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
papers_found.key_finding: Stacked meta-learner over NB + AdaBoost + MLP + KNN + XGBoost + LR base learners. Multi-model stacking consistently outperforms single best model.
papers_found.relevance: MEDIUM — GA evolves diverse models; explicit stacking of GA-champion models as meta-learner is unexplored

papers_found.title: Comparing Machine Learning Methods for NBA Game Outcome Prediction
papers_found.key_finding: Systematic comparison confirms XGBoost/LR reach Brier ~0.20 with accuracy ~0.68. Confirms 0.20 is achievable with proper features.
papers_found.relevance: MEDIUM — validates target; our 0.22019 still 0.02 above reported SOTA

papers_found.title: Integration of machine learning XGBoost and SHAP models for NBA game outcome prediction
papers_found.key_finding: SHAP analysis identifies top-3 features universally: home_advantage, team_ELO, current_form_last5. These features dominate predictive power regardless of model.
papers_found.relevance: HIGH — ELO and form are in engine.py but compete with 3377 candidates in GA; pinning them as mandatory seeds would guarantee top signal is always present

proposals.title: Shot-Chart Spatial Embeddings — New Feature Category
proposals.novelty: Not yet in engine.py. Prior proposals (LSTM, MC dropout, stacking) focused on model architecture; this adds a new feature signal type.
proposals.description: Add shooting zone distribution features to engine.py Category 55. Per-team, per-window (3g, 7g): zone_pct_paint, zone_pct_midrange, zone_pct_corner3, zone_pct_abovebreak3, opp_zone_fg_pct_paint, opp_zone_fg_pct_3pt. ~30 new features capture spatial matchup signals beyond aggregate FG%.
proposals.data_source: NBA Stats API shots endpoint (zone breakdown). Partially available in bbref advanced boxscores.
proposals.implementation: Add Category 55 SHOT_ZONE to engine.py (~30 features). Requires shot-zone data fetch in predict pipeline. VM engineering task.

proposals.title: ELO + Form as Mandatory GA Seed Features
proposals.novelty: SHAP literature confirms these are universally top-3. Our GA can accidentally drop them during mutation.
proposals.description: Pin a small set of MANDATORY_FEATURES in HF space GA that bypass the drop operator: elo_diff, home_elo_approx (or similar), team_form_last5_wins_pct, home_court_advantage. These 4 features are always included in every individual in the population. GA can still add/remove all other features freely.
proposals.implementation: Add MANDATORY_FEATURES = ['elo_diff', 'home_form_win_pct_last5', 'away_form_win_pct_last5', 'home_advantage'] to island GA config. In mutate(): skip drop operator for mandatory features. ~2h per space.
proposals.estimated_brier_gain: 0.001 (prevents regression, ensures top signal always present)

proposals.title: SHAP-Guided GA Population Initialization
proposals.description: Use SHAP values from current fleet champion (S14 extra_trees 0.22019) to bias GA initialization. Compute mean|SHAP| per feature. Set p_include(feature) proportional to SHAP rank (top-25% features get 0.9 inclusion prob, bottom-25% get 0.1). Reduces burn-in from ~200 gens to ~50 while still allowing full exploration.
proposals.implementation: Extract SHAP from champion model pickle. Serialize SHAP ranks to HF dataset. Load in GA init to set biased sampling probs. One-time setup + GA init patch.

cross_project_portability.to_political: PROP-02 (mandatory seed) directly portable to political GA: pin top-SHAP features from P4 fleet best (0.24992) as mandatory seeds. PROP-03 (SHAP-guided init) universally applicable.
cross_project_portability.from_political_to_nba: Political Rotation B finding: variance filter (VarianceThreshold 0.01) removes dead features. Same filter can be applied to NBA engine.py's 7213 raw candidates to improve GA search efficiency.

implementation_order: 1. PROP-02 — ELO mandatory seed (highest ROI/hour, 2h, no new data)
2. PROP-01 — Shot-chart embeddings (new signal, 5h, new data fetch)
3. PROP-03 — SHAP-guided init (medium-term, 4h, requires champion extraction)
